title: Declarations of intent
explain: A customer who exports regularly buys without VAT up to the amount it declared to the tax agency for a year. Record its declaration with the agency's protocol, check it on the agency's site and keep the receipt; an invoice that names it bills its lines without VAT (N3.5) and uses the amount up.

switchOff.title: Invoices do not name a declaration yet
switchOff.body: The accountant has not confirmed declarations of intent for this company: you can record and check them now; a draft names one once the switch is on in Finance settings › Tax set-up.

add.title: Add a declaration of intent
add.explain: Type what the customer's declaration says: the protocol the tax agency gave it, its date, the year it covers and the amount it declares for our supplies. It is recorded not checked yet.
add.customersFailed: The customers could not be read: close this and open it again.
add.noCustomers: This company has no customer yet.
add.protocolHint: 17 digits, a hyphen and 6 digits, as on the agency's receipt
add.yearHint: The protocol's year, or the next one
add.amountHint: Without VAT, as on the declaration

problem.protocol: The protocol is 17 digits, a hyphen and 6 digits, as on the agency's receipt.
problem.future: The protocol date is not in the future.
problem.year: A declaration covers its protocol's year or the next one.
problem.dateRefused: The protocol date was refused: it is not in the future.

failed: The declarations could not be read

empty.title: No declaration of intent covers {year}
empty.body: When a customer sends its declaration, add it here with the agency's protocol.

rule: DPR 633/1972 art. 8 c.1 lett. c: an invoice issued without VAT on a declaration that is not checked, revoked, of another year or used up is refused before its number is taken (a used-up declaration is a fine). Which checks the accountant wants stays theirs to confirm.

record.title: Declaration {protocol} · {customer}

stateWords.UNCHECKED: Not checked on the tax agency's site yet: no invoice can be issued on it until it is checked and the receipt is kept.
stateWords.CHECKED: Checked on the tax agency's site: invoices of its year may rest on it up to what is left.
stateWords.USED_UP: What it declared is used up: the next invoice to this customer carries VAT, unless it sends a new declaration.
stateWords.REVOKED: Revoked: no invoice rests on it any more, and it changes no more.

record.noInvoices: No issued invoice rests on it yet.

check.title: Record the check
check.explain: Look the protocol up on the tax agency's site, save the page it prints and add it here: the check is recorded once, with its receipt.
check.dropHint: The receipt the agency's site printed (PDF or picture, up to 10 MB)
check.heldByScan: The receipt is held by the virus check: the check is not recorded. Try again with another copy of the receipt.

revoke.title: Revoke declaration {protocol}
revoke.explain: Revoke it when the customer withdraws it or it proves not valid: no invoice rests on it after that, drafts that name it must let it go, and it changes no more.

problem.short: Say why in at least 3 characters.

held.noManage: Declarations are recorded, checked and revoked by whoever keeps the tax set-up.
held.noPrice: The amount declared is typed by whoever sees amounts.
held.noParties: Choosing the customer needs the right to see customers.
held.busy: Wait for the change under way.
held.noUpload: Adding the receipt needs the right to upload files.
held.revoked: This declaration is revoked: it changes no more.
held.noManageInvoices: Drafts are changed by whoever makes invoices.

notice.added: Declaration {protocol} recorded: check it on the tax agency's site next.
notice.checked: Declaration {protocol} checked: its receipt is kept with it.

refusal.NOT_CUSTOMER: A declaration of intent is a customer's: this party is not one of our customers.
refusal.REVOKED: This declaration was revoked meanwhile: it changes no more.
refusal.CHECKED: This declaration was checked meanwhile: the check is recorded once.
refusal.RECEIPT: The receipt must be a file added on this declaration and ready in the store: add it again.
refusal.SWITCH_OFF: Declarations of intent wait for the accountant: a draft names one once the switch is on in Finance settings › Tax set-up.
refusal.DECLARATION: This document rests on no declaration: a credit note gives back what the invoice it credits used.
refusal.DATABASE: The database refused the change: nothing was saved. Try again.
refusal.NOT_FOUND: This declaration is no longer there, or not this customer's: the list is read again.
